profiles.Summary: Persona 4 Golden is a lightly demanding 2D/3D JRPG port that runs excellently on the Steam Deck, easily hitting 60 fps with headroom to spare given its modest PC requirements. The game is Steam Deck Verified and plays great out of the box with full controller support.

MaxBattery.Notes: At 4 W TDP and a reduced render resolution with FSR upscaling, the Deck sips power while keeping P4G perfectly playable. This profile is ideal for long travel sessions; the game's 2D art style masks the lower resolution well.

The game is Steam Deck Verified and generally runs excellently under Proton with no major compatibility hurdles reported.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the game's very modest PC requirements (GTX 460-class recommended) relative to the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU. On your first run, confirm the frame rate is stable in the busiest areas (Junes shopping district, dungeons) and raise or lower TDP accordingly.

MaxBattery.Notes: At 4 W TDP and a low GPU clock, P4G runs locked at 40 fps with ease; FSR upscales the reduced render resolution cleanly. This profile prioritises all-day handheld sessions over visual fidelity.
